recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD7（FITC）對 CD13（PE）密度圖：主要族群落在第 2 象限，同時表現 CD7 與 CD13；CD7 是 T-ALL 最敏感的 T 細胞標記，而 CD13 屬於異常表現的骨髓系抗原，這種組合可見於 T-ALL（尤其是早期 T 前驅型 ETP-ALL）。
features: Flow cytometry density plot of CD7 FITC (x-axis) versus CD13 PE (y-axis) with quadrant markers
Dominant population in quadrant 2, co-expressing CD7 and CD13
Minor tail of events extending into CD7-negative CD13-positive quadrant 1
Few events in the double-negative quadrant 3 and none in quadrant 4
describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD7 versus CD13 on the gated population shows a dominant cluster in quadrant 2 co-expressing CD7 and the myeloid-associated antigen CD13, with a minor tail of CD7-negative CD13-positive events. In the context of T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, CD7 expression supports T lineage, while CD13 represents aberrant myeloid antigen expression. Co-expression of myeloid or stem cell markers with CD7, especially with CD1a and CD8 negativity and weak or absent CD5, raises the possibility of early T-precursor lymphoblastic leukemia; cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO are needed to exclude mixed phenotype acute leukemia.
